# Component sizing (modeled; auto-generated by reports/component_sizing.py)

All values are time-history statistics from the experiments named; conditions on every row. Tag: modeled. Torques are at the rotor (generator) shaft; multiply by r to get the axial force on the drive rod.

## 1. Sprag clutches (Formsprag input)

Engagements per km per clutch set (A = collapse stroke, B = expansion stroke), transmitted torque 99th percentile and max at the rotor, lock-up impulse (0 when backlash = 0), race speed vs catalog lift-off (1200 rpm mid-range), and km to 10^6 engagements of the busier clutch.

| vehicle | klass | mph | c_s_scale | r | J | c_gen | P_elec | N_eng_A_km | N_eng_B_km | T_c_p99 | T_c_max | race_rpm_max | engaged_frac | km_to_1e6_cycles_per_clutch |

| midsize_car | A | 30 | 1 | 300 | 3e-05 | 0.01 | 0.3 | 454 | 454 | 0.16 | 0.22 | 203 | 0.95 | 2203 |
| midsize_car | A | 60 | 0.25 | 300 | 3e-05 | 0.01 | 1.2 | 304 | 308 | 0.34 | 0.40 | 357 | 0.94 | 3248 |
| midsize_car | A | 60 | 1 | 300 | 3e-05 | 0.01 | 0.6 | 228 | 230 | 0.22 | 0.27 | 243 | 0.95 | 4346 |

| midsize_car | B | 30 | 1 | 300 | 3e-05 | 0.01 | 1.2 | 454 | 454 | 0.33 | 0.45 | 406 | 0.95 | 2203 |

Reading: engagement counts are set by the road's zero-crossing rate (roughly the body-mode frequency), not by the load; the torque envelope scales with c_gen·ω. If the catalog rating basis is 10^6 full-torque cycles (not verified, 04_prior_art item 6), the km column is the service interval at catalog torque; size the clutch so T_c_p99 is well below catalog torque with an indexing service factor of 2–6.

## 2. Flywheel inertia vs shaft-speed ripple

ripple = std(rpm)/mean(rpm) over the stationary window; engaged = fraction of time a clutch is locked; frac_1600 = fraction of time above a claw-pole alternator cut-in (1600 rpm).

| gate_J | gate_r | Jr | P_elec | rpm_mean | rpm_p05 | rpm_p95 | ripple | engaged | frac_1600 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3e-05 | 300 | 2.7 | 10.4 | 484 | 64 | 1187 | 0.74 | 0.89 | 0.01 |
| 3e-05 | 1484 | 66.1 | 2.1 | 209 | 22 | 497 | 0.72 | 0.97 | 0.00 |
| 3e-04 | 300 | 27.0 | 10.0 | 508 | 202 | 964 | 0.46 | 0.65 | 0.00 |
| 3e-04 | 1484 | 660.7 | 2.0 | 215 | 65 | 454 | 0.56 | 0.93 | 0.00 |

Reading: J trades ripple against reflected inertance J r² on the stroke (F2). A claw-pole alternator needs frac_1600 ≈ 1 to make anything; at the low-r points it never gets there, which is why the generator must be a PM machine wound for the actual speed band.

Reading: the machine must make its rated power at a few hundred to ~1500 rpm with torque of order 0.1–1 N·m at r = 300 rad/m; raising r raises speed and lowers torque but raises J r² (F2).
